# Pure Fire Nutritional

> Pure Fire Nutritional is a US-based retailer of oral Khavinson peptide bioregulators (Cytomax, Cytogen, Revilab, and Prime Peptide lines) and longevity-focused dietary supplements. The site also offers Pepita AI, a research assistant for exploring published peptide bioregulator literature.

Peptide bioregulators are short-chain peptides that researchers have investigated for their potential role in supporting the normal function of specific tissues. They are believed to act as signaling molecules; research is ongoing and findings are preliminary.

These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. Products sold by Pure Fire Nutritional are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before using any supplement.
